skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the process of developing, operating, and managing knowledge management systems to support organizational operations, management, and leadership.
Analyze, design, operate, and manage knowledge management systems in organizations.
Work independently or actively and effectively in group activities.
Participate actively and effectively in group activities.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of management information systems.
Self-study and read literature on knowledge management.
